person.name: Гарік Носач (Garik Nosach)
person.possible_legal_first_name: Ігор (Ihor/Igor) — his second Instagram handle is @nosuch.igor, and 'Гарік' is a common Ukrainian/Russian diminutive of Ігор; not independently confirmed
person.city: Тарту / Таллінн, Естонія (Tartu / Tallinn, Estonia); previously ~8 years in Kyiv
person.background: ~10 years in fintech, rising from support to CEO; quit his job and sold property to pursue cooking after trips to Japan and Korea; wants to open an omakase-inspired restaurant (inspiration from Osaka). Cooking style described as Nordic-philosophy fusion; judge Klopotenko praised his fish dishes.
person.result: Reached the Top 8; eliminated in episode 15 (aired 06.12.2025) after the Black Apron battle (breakfast dish that failed the main condition, undercooked syrnyky, unbalanced flavours). Halyna's salmon won that battle.
notes: Identity match is high confidence: Google/Bing surface the @nosuch.garik profile title as 'Топ 8 МастерШеф 16 (@nosuch.garik) - Гарік Носач', matching the STB season-16 contestant page.

Post-show he was reported to be planning a Ukrainian-Asian food truck, and was chosen by judge Olia Martynovska for an internship at her restaurant — a fan channel later reported the internship did not go ahead.
Season 16 ran 18 episodes; he appears in episodes 1-15. The season winner was Sashko (Oleksandr).
Episode 15 is the only full episode where he is eliminated; episodes 1-15 all feature him as a contestant.
